entries.def:
κῶμος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Wis.14.23, 2Ma.6.4 * ;] 
a revel, carousal: Rom.13.13, Gal.5.21, 1Pe.4.3.†
SYN.: see: κραιπάλη (AS)
a gnat, mosquito , Lat. culex, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

Κῶς genitive Κῶ, ἡ, 
Cos, an island in the Ægean Sea: accusative Κῶ, Act.21.1 (Κῶν, Rec.).†
(AS)

κωφός, -ή, -όν
(κόπτω), [in LXX chiefly (Exo.4.11, al.) for אִלֵּם; for חָרָשׁ, Hab.2.18 ;] 
blunt, dull. Metaphorical, of the senses, esp. 
__(a) of speech, dumb: Mat.9.32-33; 12.22; 15.30-31, Luk.1.22; 11.14; 
__(b) of hearing, deaf: Mat.11.5, Mrk.7.32, 37; 9.25, Luk.7.22.†
(AS)

λαγχάνω 
[in LXX: 1Sa.14.47 (לָכַד, see Th., Gr., 38), Wis.8.19, 3Mac 61 * ;] 
__1. to obtain by lot, to obtain (in cl., with genitive): with inf. art. (B1., § 36, 3; 71, 3), Luk.1.9 with accusative of thing(s), Act.1.17, 2Pe.1.1. 
__2. to draw lots: before περί, Jhn.19.24 
(AS)

Λάζαρος, -ου, ὁ 
colloquial abbreviation of Ἐλεαζάρ (άζαρος), which see), 
Lazarus; 
__1. of Bethany: Jhn.11.1 ff. Jhn.12.1-2, 9-10; 12.17. 
__2. The beggar in the parable: Luk.16.20, 23-25.†
(AS)

adv., [in LXX chiefly for ‎סֵתֶר ;] 
secretly: Mat.1.19; 2.7, Mrk.5.33 (WH, mg.), Jhn.11.28, Act.16.37.†
(AS)

λαῖλαψ, -απος, ἡ 
[in LXX: Job.21.18; 27.20 א (סוּפָה) Job.38.1, Jer.25.32 (סַעַר), Wis.5.14, 23, Sir.48.9, 12 * ;] 
a hurricane, whirlwind: Mrk.4.37, Luk.8.23, 2Pe.2.17.†
SYN.: θύελλα, which see, and cf. ἄνεμος (AS)

λακτίζω
(λάξ, with the foot), 
to kick: Act.26.14.†
(AS)
